--==================================================
-- SLIDER CREATOR
--==================================================

local sliders = {}

local function createSlider(name, y, minValue, maxValue, defaultValue, suffix)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 24)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, y)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 225)
	label.TextSize = 13
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = content

	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 7)
	bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, y + 30)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Parent = content

	local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	barCorner.Parent = bar

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 80, 220)
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = bar

	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill

	local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	knob.Text = ""
	knob.Parent = bar

	local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	knobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	knobCorner.Parent = knob

	local value = defaultValue
	local dragging = false

	local function update(newValue)

		value = math.clamp(newValue, minValue, maxValue)

		local percent =
			(value - minValue) /
			(maxValue - minValue)

		fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)

		if maxValue - minValue >= 10 then
			label.Text =
				name .. ": " .. math.floor(value + 0.5) .. suffix
		else
			label.Text =
				name .. ": " .. string.format("%.2f", value) .. suffix
		end
	end

	local function setFromX(x)

		local percent =
			(x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) /
			bar.AbsoluteSize.X

		update(
			minValue +
			(maxValue - minValue) *
			math.clamp(percent, 0, 1)
		)
	end

	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)

	knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

		if dragging then

			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

				setFromX(input.Position.X)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = false
		end
	end)

	update(defaultValue)

	local slider = {}

	function slider:Get()
		return value
	end

	function slider:Set(newValue)
		update(newValue)
	end

	return slider
end

--==================================================

	enabled = not enabled

	if enabled then
		toggle.Text = "VOID: ON"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
	else
		toggle.Text = "VOID: OFF"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CAMERA TOGGLE
--==================================================

cameraButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	stableCamera = not stableCamera

	if stableCamera then
		cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: ON"
		cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
	else
		cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: OFF"
		cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESET
--==================================================

reset.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	distanceSlider:Set(DEFAULT_DISTANCE)
	voidTimeSlider:Set(DEFAULT_VOID_TIME)
	returnTimeSlider:Set(DEFAULT_RETURN_TIME)

	stableCamera = true
	cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: ON"
	cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
end)

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER
--==================================================

local function getCharacter()

	local character = player.Character
		or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	local root =
		character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if root then
		return character, root
	end
end

--==================================================
-- VOID LOOP
--==================================================

task.spawn(function()

	while gui.Parent do

		task.wait(0.01)

		if enabled and not busy then

			local character, root = getCharacter()

			if character and root then

				busy = true

				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

				-- Save camera position before teleport
				local savedCameraCFrame

				if stableCamera and camera then
					savedCameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
				end

				-- Save player position
				local returnCFrame = root.CFrame

				VOID_DISTANCE = distanceSlider:Get()
				VOID_TIME = voidTimeSlider:Get()
				RETURN_TIME = returnTimeSlider:Get()

				-- Teleport downward
				root.CFrame =
					returnCFrame *
					CFrame.new(0, -VOID_DISTANCE, 0)

				-- Keep camera visually stable
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then

					local endTime =
						os.clock() + VOID_TIME

					while os.clock() < endTime do

						if camera and camera.Parent then
							camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
						end

						task.wait()
					end

				else
					task.wait(VOID_TIME)
				end

				-- Return player
				if root and root.Parent then
					root.CFrame = returnCFrame
				end

				-- Restore camera again
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then
					camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
				end

				task.wait(RETURN_TIME)

				busy = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZE / RESTORE
--==================================================

minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	minimized = not minimized

	if minimized then

		-- Hide content
		content.Visible = false

		-- Shrink window
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 48)

		-- Change button
		minimize.Text = "□"

	else

		-- Restore window
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 380)

		-- Show content
		content.Visible = true

		minimize.Text = "—"
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CLOSE
--==================================================

	enabled = false

	if workspace.CurrentCamera then
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType =
			Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end

	gui:Destroy()
end)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if dragging then

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			local delta =
				input.Position - dragStart

			main.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESPAWN SAFETY
--==================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	busy = false
end)

local function createExplosionEffect(targetCFrame)
    local spawnBlock = Instance.new("Part")
    spawnBlock.Name = "DestructionBlock8x8"
    spawnBlock.Size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
    spawnBlock.CFrame = targetCFrame
    spawnBlock.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
    spawnBlock.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    spawnBlock.Anchored = true
    spawnBlock.CanCollide = false
    spawnBlock.Parent = workspace

    local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
    explosion.Position = targetCFrame.Position
    explosion.BlastRadius = 16
    explosion.BlastPressure = 1000000
    explosion.Parent = workspace

    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, spawnBlock}
    end

    local partsInZone = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(targetCFrame, Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), overlapParams)

    for _, part in pairs(partsInZone) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and part.Name ~= "Terrain" then
            if not part:IsGrounded() or part.Anchored then
                part.Anchored = false
            end
            part:BreakJoints()
            task.spawn(function()
                part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark orange")
                task.wait(0.1)
                part:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    task.delay(0.5, function()
        if spawnBlock and spawnBlock.Parent then
            spawnBlock:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

local function getCharacterParts()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return char, root, hum
end

local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	if flyConnection then
		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil
	end
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

	local _, _, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
end

local function startFly()
	local _, root, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if not root or not hum then return end

	flying = true
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyGyro.P = 9e4
	bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 90)

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local _, r, h = getCharacterParts()
		if not r or not h or not bodyVelocity then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camCF = camera.CFrame
		local direction = Vector3.zero

		-- WASD / mobile thumbstick (relative to where the camera looks)
		local moveDir = h.MoveDirection
		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end
			local forwardAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatLook)
			local rightAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatRight)
			direction = camCF.LookVector * forwardAmt + camCF.RightVector * rightAmt
		end

		-- Up / down (only when not typing in a textbox)
		if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
				direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
				or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
				direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
		end

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
			direction = direction.Unit
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
	end)
end

	if flying then

	else

local function performSafeTeleport()
    local targetCFrame = getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame
    if not targetCFrame then return false end
    
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return false end

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

    local currentPos = hrp.Position
    local targetPos = targetCFrame.Position
    local distance = (targetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

    if distance > STEP_DISTANCE then
        local steps = math.ceil(distance / STEP_DISTANCE)
        for i = 1, steps do
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then break end
            local alpha = i / steps
            hrp.CFrame = currentPos:Lerp(targetPos, alpha) * targetCFrame.Rotation
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    else
        hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    return true

local function HideCharacter(Character)

			Object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1

		elseif Object:IsA("Decal") or Object:IsA("Texture") then
			Object.Transparency = 1
		end
	end
end

local function KeepCharacterHidden(Character)

	task.spawn(function()

		while Character.Parent do

			for _, Object in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do

				if Object:IsA("BasePart") then

					if Object.Name ~= "ClientMorph" then
						Object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
					end

				elseif Object:IsA("Decal") or Object:IsA("Texture") then
					Object.Transparency = 1
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)

local function CreateMorph(Character)

	local Root =
		Character:WaitForChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart",
			10
		)

	if not Root then
		warn("Morph: HumanoidRootPart not found")
		return
	end

	local OldMorph =
		Character:FindFirstChild("ClientMorph")

	if OldMorph then
		OldMorph:Destroy()
	end

	HideCharacter(Character)
	KeepCharacterHidden(Character)

	local Holder = Instance.new("Part")

	Holder.Name = "ClientMorph"
	Holder.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)

	Holder.Transparency = 0

	Holder.CanCollide = false
	Holder.CanTouch = false
	Holder.CanQuery = false
	Holder.Massless = true
	Holder.CastShadow = false
	Holder.Anchored = false

	Holder.Parent = Character

	local Mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")

	Mesh.Name = "MorphMesh"

	Mesh.MeshType =
		Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

	Mesh.MeshId = MESH_ID

	Mesh.TextureId =
		CurrentTexture

	Mesh.Scale =
		MESH_SCALE

	Mesh.Parent = Holder

	CurrentMorph = Mesh

	Holder.CFrame =
		Root.CFrame *
		CFrame.new(0, MORPH_Y_OFFSET, 0)

	local Weld = Instance.new("Weld")

	Weld.Name = "MorphWeld"

	Weld.Part0 = Root
	Weld.Part1 = Holder

	Weld.C0 =
		CFrame.new(0, MORPH_Y_OFFSET, 0)

	Weld.Parent = Holder

	NormalWeld = Weld
end

local function StopGrab()

	GrabEnabled = false

	if GrabWeld then
		GrabWeld:Destroy()
		GrabWeld = nil
	end

	if CurrentMorph and CurrentMorph.Parent then

		local Holder =
			CurrentMorph.Parent

		local Character =
			Player.Character

		local Root =
			Character and
			Character:FindFirstChild(
				"HumanoidRootPart"
			)

		if Root then

			Holder.CFrame =
				Root.CFrame *
				CFrame.new(
					0,
					MORPH_Y_OFFSET,
					0
				)

			local Weld =
				Instance.new("Weld")

			Weld.Name = "MorphWeld"

			Weld.Part0 = Root
			Weld.Part1 = Holder

			Weld.C0 =
				CFrame.new(
					0,
					MORPH_Y_OFFSET,
					0
				)

			Weld.Parent = Holder

			NormalWeld = Weld
		end
	end

	-- Restore camera
	CameraFollowing = false

	Camera.CameraType =
		Enum.CameraType.Custom

	local Character =
		Player.Character

	local Humanoid =
		Character and
		Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	if Humanoid then
		Camera.CameraSubject = Humanoid
	end
end

--==================================================
-- START GRAB
--==================================================

local function StartGrab(TargetPlayer)

	if not CurrentMorph then
		return false
	end

	if not TargetPlayer then
		return false
	end

	local TargetCharacter =
		TargetPlayer.Character

	if not TargetCharacter then
		return false
	end

	local Hand =
		TargetCharacter:FindFirstChild(
			"RightHand"
		)
		or TargetCharacter:FindFirstChild(
			"Right Arm"
		)

	if not Hand then
		return false
	end

	local Holder =
		CurrentMorph.Parent

	if not Holder then
		return false
	end

	if NormalWeld then
		NormalWeld:Destroy()
		NormalWeld = nil
	end

	if GrabWeld then
		GrabWeld:Destroy()
		GrabWeld = nil
	end

	SelectedPlayer =
		TargetPlayer

	GrabEnabled = true

	Holder.CFrame =
		Hand.CFrame *
		CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)

	local Weld =
		Instance.new("Weld")

	Weld.Name = "GrabWeld"

	Weld.Part0 = Hand
	Weld.Part1 = Holder

	Weld.C0 =
		CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)

	Weld.Parent = Holder

	GrabWeld = Weld

	-- Camera follows target
	CameraFollowing = true

	Camera.CameraType =
		Enum.CameraType.Custom

	local TargetHumanoid =
		TargetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	if TargetHumanoid then
		Camera.CameraSubject =
			TargetHumanoid
	else
		Camera.CameraSubject =
			TargetCharacter
	end

	return true
end

local Dragging = false
local DragStart
local StartPosition

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

	if Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		Dragging = true
		DragStart = Input.Position
		StartPosition = Main.Position

		Input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if Input.UserInputState ==
				Enum.UserInputState.End then

				Dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

	if not Dragging then
		return
	end

	if Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local Delta =
			Input.Position - DragStart

		Main.Position =
			UDim2.new(
				StartPosition.X.Scale,
				StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				StartPosition.Y.Scale,
				StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
			)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- DRAG GRAB GUI
--==================================================

local GrabDragging = false
local GrabDragStart
local GrabStartPosition

GrabTitle.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

	if Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		GrabDragging = true
		GrabDragStart = Input.Position
		GrabStartPosition = GrabFrame.Position

		Input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if Input.UserInputState ==
				Enum.UserInputState.End then

				GrabDragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

	if not GrabDragging then
		return
	end

	if Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local Delta =
			Input.Position - GrabDragStart

		GrabFrame.Position =
			UDim2.new(
				GrabStartPosition.X.Scale,
				GrabStartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				GrabStartPosition.Y.Scale,
				GrabStartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
			)
	end
end)

--==================================================

local function StartMorph(Character)

	task.wait(1)

	if not Character or not Character.Parent then
		return
	end

	CreateMorph(Character)

	task.wait(0.3)

	if Buttons["Normal"] then

		SelectFace(

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(
	function(Character)

		GrabEnabled = false
		SelectedPlayer = nil
		GrabWeld = nil
		NormalWeld = nil

		CurrentMorph = nil
		SelectedButton = nil

		task.spawn(function()
			StartMorph(Character)
		end)

        v = tonumber(v)
        if not v then v = current end
        v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        current = v
        local t = (max == min) and 0 or (v - min) / (max - min)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(t, 0, 1, 0)

    end

    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local function update(i)
                local rel = (i.Position.X - track_.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track_.AbsoluteSize.X)
                rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
                set(min + rel * (max - min), true)
            end
            activeDrag = update
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if enter then set(box.Text, true) end
    end)

    set(default, true)
    return { set = set, get = function() return current end, frame = row }

local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    end
    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

local function ensureSound()
    if state.sound and state.sound.Parent then return state.sound end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end
end

local function resumeSound()
    if state.sound and not state.playing then
        state.sound:Resume()
        state.playing = true
        setStatus("Resumed.")
    end
end
